description: List the most recently updated compliance nodes: the regulatory change feed. Use to monitor incoming amendments, new guidance, or freshly added rules. Filter by pillar to focus on a domain. Agents should call this on a schedule to keep compliance posture current.

days.description: Look back N days. Default 30. Max 180.

pillar.description: Optional pillar filter, e.g. "AI Governance" or "Cybersecurity".

name: get_latest_changes
